response.overview: A promotional and technical film produced by the McDonnell Aircraft Company, a division of McDonnell Douglas, on the carrier suitability of the F/A-18 Hornet. Opening with archive footage of the first shipboard aircraft landing in 1911, it sets out what a naval aircraft must demonstrate before it can operate from a carrier deck, then follows the Hornet through sea trials, deck handling, launches and recoveries, with interviews with the pilots who flew it.
response.title: The Bottom Line... Carrier Suitability
